question: Why is Shiva not divided among the mantras?
premises: Mantras are those lords in fivefold.
inference: Shiva is not divided because he is one light-dense consciousness, unlike the mantras and mantra-lords.
uncertainties: The exact relation of the fivefold and threefold groups is not fully explicit.
plain_english: Mantras are those lords in fivefold, mantra-lords are threefold, but Shiva is not divided, being one light-dense consciousness.
